The mechanisms are complementary, but T2's tap reuse and T3's spatial blocking could overlap; sharpen T2 to one-sweep line-level work and T3 to cross-timestep data reuse. Add controls within T1 and T3 to distinguish persistent-region overhead and temporal fusion from simpler alternatives. revisions.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare the serial baseline with static row-level OpenMP work sharing using both a parallel region per timestep and one persistent region across all six timesteps. Honor the `threads` budget without relying on global OpenMP state; retain a low-overhead serial path where appropriate. Keep SIMD and temporal blocking out of scope. Verify the full output and boundary behavior on smaller checks and n=256; measure under the official one- and four-core settings so parallel-region overhead and scaling are distinguishable.

revisions.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, compare spatial blocking within one timestep against halo-correct fusion of multiple consecutive timesteps per tile. Account for the radius-3 expanding halo, the recurrence's dependence on both time levels, even/odd buffer parity, and untouched boundaries. Keep explicit SIMD and thread parallelization out of scope; include scratch allocation in timing. Preserve full output initialization and numerical tolerance, validate smaller checks and n=256, and record correct results even if a variant is slower, since it may inform a later combination.
